title: 守卫
text:
最后一道门有精英守着：更硬，带的东西也更好。输给精英扣的体力更多。

和刚才一样先进{ui:战前准备}：看清对手的棋盘，把新搜到的也放进包里，调整好位置再按{ui:开战}。

它披着甲，普通刀剑每下都要被削掉一截；{item:poisoned_knife}的毒不看这个。

texts.en:
An elite guards the last door: tougher, and better equipped. Losing to an elite costs more Vitality.

Same as before, go through {ui:战前准备} first: read the enemy's board, put your new finds in your bag, adjust where everything sits, then press {ui:开战}.

It's armored, so ordinary blades lose a chunk of every hit. The poison on a {item:poisoned_knife} doesn't care.

options.label: 进入战前准备
options.hint_when_hidden: 先把{item:poison_vial}拖到{item:knife}上面合成{item:poisoned_knife}（按 {key:B} 打开背包）。

hints_when_hidden.en: First drag the {item:poison_vial} onto the {item:knife} to craft a {item:poisoned_knife} (press {key:B} to open your pack).

labels.en: No {item:knife} on hand. Go in anyway
